description: A multi_agent helper's requests come on the parent's session with a toolCallId never announced (Codex's child threads, codex-acp 2.2.2). With Run(wc -l notes.txt) and Edit(*) kept: the helper's identical command is answered allow_once by the host; another command reaches the lawyer on a card that offers no Always (the card cannot show the command); the kept command in a folder outside the matter reaches the lawyer; a write to a document Word holds open is refused

note: initialize: written from codex-acp 2.2.2 source until G8a's recordings replace it.

codex-acp's initialize, src/CodexAcpServer.ts, dist/index.js:42416-42501 (session caps :42435-42443), written from codex-acp 2.2.2 source until G8a's recordings replace it. Trimmed what SDK schema 1.11.0 drops: mcpCapabilities.acp and sessionCapabilities.fork (unstable features) and sessionCapabilities.subagents (no stable field). authMethods is [] although codex-acp lists api-key and chat-gpt (src/CodexAuthMethod.ts, dist/index.js:33234-33277): the host never calls authenticate on this path, and the method shapes are not recorded yet. _meta.steering is kept, now that the host reads it: codex-acp maps _session/steering onto turn/steer (research 31 §2.2) and has no claudeCode.promptQueueing, so the host steers it as send now.
codex-acp's modes, src/AgentMode.ts, dist/index.js:34243-34354, current "agent" (its default), written from codex-acp 2.2.2 source until G8a's recordings replace it; descriptions left out.
